data.title: About CinaGroup — Practical systems for real work

texts.label: SEO / Page Description
texts.value: CinaGroup builds practical tools for search, workflow automation, model access, reusable skills, and connected infrastructure.

texts.label: Hero / Title
texts.value: Build useful systems without hiding how they work.

texts.label: Hero / Lead
texts.value: CinaGroup brings search, workflow automation, model access, reusable skills, and connected infrastructure into one practical product stack.

texts.label: Mission / Heading
texts.value: Make advanced infrastructure understandable enough to adopt responsibly.

texts.label: Mission / Paragraph
texts.value: Technology becomes useful when teams can see its boundaries, connect it to a real workflow, and verify the outcome.

texts.label: Mission / Paragraph / 2
texts.value: Keep inputs, sources, policies, review points, and delivery states visible to the people operating the product.

texts.label: Mission / Paragraph / 3
texts.value: Choose one valuable workflow and improve it before expanding into a broader platform story.

texts.label: Mission / Paragraph / 4
texts.value: Match human review, access boundaries, auditability, and recovery paths to the impact of the action.

texts.label: Stack / Map / Paragraph
texts.value: Each product can stand alone. Together they support workflows that need knowledge, action, access, reusable capability, and connected state.

texts.label: Stack / Map / Item / Description
texts.value: Search across documents, product context, support history, and operating knowledge.

texts.label: Stack / Map / Item / Description / 2
texts.value: Move repeated operational work through visible context gathering and review.

texts.label: Stack / Map / Item / Description / 3
texts.value: Centralize model access, routing policy, usage boundaries, and request traces.

texts.label: Stack / Map / Item / Description / 4
texts.value: Package small, reviewable, versioned capabilities for reuse across workflows.

texts.label: Stack / Map / Item / Description / 5
texts.value: Connect application state and services through explicit contracts and releases.

texts.label: Working / Model / Paragraph
texts.value: We prefer evidence-backed increments: inspect the live and source state, define a coherent change, implement it, and prove the result in the environment that matters.

texts.label: About / Cta / Heading
texts.value: Bring a workflow that needs clarity.

texts.label: About / Cta / Paragraph
texts.value: We can help map the right product, service boundary, and first acceptance scope.

data.title: Services — Product, workflow, and platform delivery

texts.label: SEO / Page Description
texts.value: CinaGroup helps teams audit, design, implement, and harden search, automation, model gateway, and connected infrastructure workflows.

texts.label: Services / 1 / Description
texts.value: Map the current user journey, systems, content, constraints, and failure points before deciding what to build.

texts.label: Services / 2 / Description
texts.value: Define source boundaries, retrieval flows, citations, access rules, and feedback loops for operational search.

texts.label: Services / 3 / Description
texts.value: Turn repeatable work into small flows with clear inputs, context gathering, review points, and outcomes.

texts.label: Services / 4 / Description
texts.value: Create understandable service boundaries for credentials, routing, policy, traces, and application integration.

texts.label: Services / 5 / Description
texts.value: Move from approved design to tested code, observable delivery, deployment checks, and a defined recovery path.

texts.label: Services / 6 / Description
texts.value: Use support signals, usage evidence, and workflow outcomes to prioritize the next practical improvement.

texts.label: Hero / Eyebrow
texts.value: Services / from current state to reviewed release.

texts.label: Hero / Title
texts.value: Make the next product change understandable before it becomes expensive.

texts.label: Hero / Lead
texts.value: CinaGroup helps teams audit, design, implement, and harden search, automation, gateway, and connected infrastructure workflows.

texts.label: Services / Heading
texts.value: Start with the job, not a generic package.

texts.label: Services / Paragraph
texts.value: Each engagement is scoped around a real workflow and the systems, risks, and review points that make it succeed.

texts.label: Delivery / Paragraph
texts.value: We keep the current state, proposed change, implementation boundary, and acceptance evidence visible throughout the work.

texts.label: Delivery / Item / Description
texts.value: Capture the live experience, source architecture, content risks, accessibility issues, and measurable technical constraints.

texts.label: Delivery / Item / Description / 2
texts.value: Translate the findings into a prioritized design and implementation scope tied to user and business outcomes.

texts.label: Delivery / Item / Description / 3
texts.value: Deliver in reviewable increments with shared patterns, realistic content, and explicit integration boundaries.

texts.label: Delivery / Item / Description / 4
texts.value: Run static checks, responsive QA, interaction tests, deployment checks, and production sampling before handoff.

texts.label: Scope / Heading
texts.value: Bring one workflow and its constraints.

texts.label: Scope / Paragraph
texts.value: A strong starting brief names the user, current systems, desired outcome, sensitive actions, deployment target, and evidence required for acceptance.

texts.label: Services / Cta / Heading
texts.value: Start with the smallest valuable scope.

texts.label: Services / Cta / Paragraph
texts.value: Share the workflow that is slow, unclear, fragile, or expensive. We will help identify the first useful slice.

texts.value: Tell CinaGroup about the user, workflow, systems, constraints, and outcome you want to improve.

texts.label: Hero / Title
texts.value: Tell us what your team is trying to move.

texts.label: Hero / Lead

data.title: Pricing — Scope the work before the quote

texts.label: SEO / Page Description
texts.value: CinaGroup prices work around the workflow, systems, risk, and acceptance evidence required—not a generic template plan.

texts.label: Engagements / 1 / Note
texts.value: Best for a product, page group, workflow, or technical surface that needs evidence-backed priorities.

texts.label: Engagements / 1 / Items / 2
texts.value: UX, content, accessibility, and technical findings

texts.label: Engagements / 1 / Items / 4
texts.value: Acceptance criteria for the next step

texts.label: Engagements / 2 / Note
texts.value: Best when the target, constraints, and desired outcome are understood well enough to build and verify.

texts.label: Engagements / 3 / Note
texts.value: Best for products that need iterative delivery, integration work, operational follow-through, and release discipline.

texts.label: Hero / Title
texts.value: Price the work around the outcome, not a template.

texts.label: Hero / Lead
texts.value: The right scope depends on the workflow, systems, risk, integration depth, and evidence required for acceptance. We make those inputs visible before quoting.

texts.label: Scope / Factors / Item / Description
texts.value: Number of user journeys, page archetypes, roles, locales, and states included in the acceptance scope.

texts.label: Scope / Factors / Item / Description / 2
texts.value: Existing architecture, data sources, APIs, authentication, infrastructure, and migration requirements.

texts.label: Scope / Factors / Item / Description / 3
texts.value: Security, privacy, legal, financial, destructive, or externally visible actions that need stronger controls.

texts.label: Scope / Factors / Item / Description / 4
texts.value: Automated checks, browser coverage, environments, deployment targets, production validation, and documentation.

texts.label: Pricing / Process / Heading
texts.value: A short discovery reduces expensive assumptions.

texts.label: Pricing / Process / Paragraph
texts.value: We confirm the current state, desired outcome, in-scope systems, exclusions, dependencies, and acceptance evidence before proposing the work.

texts.label: SEO / Page Description
texts.value: CinaSeek is an early-access environment for AI agents and sandboxed personal apps built on Cloudflare Workers and workerd.

texts.label: Hero / Title
texts.value: Build and run private AI-assisted apps inside capability-based sandboxes.

texts.label: Hero / Lead
texts.value: CinaSeek combines agent chat, personal applications called Gadgets, and scoped Gatekeepers. The project is early access; production readiness depends on the release and deployment configuration.

texts.label: Capabilities / 1 / Title
texts.value: Work through an agent chat UI.

texts.label: Capabilities / 1 / Description
texts.value: Ask an agent to complete tasks or build a focused personal application for the work in front of you.

texts.label: Capabilities / 2 / Description
texts.value: Generate small applications whose client and server run in isolated, per-user boundaries.

texts.label: Capabilities / 3 / Description
texts.value: Keep each Gadget private by default, then grant access to named users or through a deliberate share link.

texts.label: Capabilities / 4 / Description
texts.value: Use Gatekeepers to narrow authorization to the specific external resources a user intended.

texts.label: Capabilities / 5 / Description
texts.value: Log external actions and preserve human approval for operations with side effects.

texts.label: Capabilities / 6 / Title
texts.value: Develop locally, deploy through the documented path.

texts.label: Capabilities / 6 / Description
texts.value: Use workerd for local development and the documented Cloudflare path for production deployment.

texts.label: Hero / Workflow / Title
texts.value: Move from a request to a sandboxed personal app.

texts.label: Hero / Workflow / Lead
texts.value: A reference evaluation keeps the requested job, generated Gadget, introduced resources, and review queue visible.

texts.label: Workflow / 1 / Description
texts.value: Describe the result, intended users, data sensitivity, and external resources required.

texts.label: Workflow / 2 / Description
texts.value: Let the agent generate the focused client/server application inside its isolated workspace.

texts.label: Workflow / 3 / Description
texts.value: Connect only the approved external resources through Gatekeepers and explicit capabilities.

texts.label: Workflow / 4 / Description
texts.value: Inspect queued side effects, test the result, and choose whether to keep it private or share it.

texts.label: Principles / 1 / Description
texts.value: Agents and Gadgets begin without ambient access to external resources.

texts.label: Principles / 2 / Description
texts.value: Each Gadget runs in an isolated boundary and is shared only through an explicit user action.

texts.label: Principles / 3 / Description
texts.value: Actions with side effects should remain logged and available for human approval.

texts.label: Shared / Capabilities / Heading
texts.value: A focused layer for the work your team needs to finish.

texts.label: Shared / Technical / Paragraph
texts.value: Use explicit inputs, review points, and outputs so the system is easier to operate and change.

texts.label: Shared / Product / Cta / Heading
texts.value: Map this product to one real workflow.

texts.label: Shared / Product / Cta / Paragraph
texts.value: Tell us the work, systems, constraints, and review points your team already has. We will help identify a sensible starting scope.

texts.label: SEO / Page Description
texts.value: CinaClaw is an open-source personal AI assistant with a local-first Gateway, channel adapters, skills, and companion apps.

texts.label: Hero / Title
texts.value: Run an assistant through your own local-first Gateway.

texts.label: Hero / Lead
texts.value: CinaClaw provides an installable CLI, Gateway, Control UI, messaging adapters, skills, and optional companion apps. Channel access and model credentials remain configuration the operator controls.

texts.label: Capabilities / 1 / Description
texts.value: Configure the Gateway, workspace, models, channels, and skills from a documented onboarding path.

texts.label: Capabilities / 2 / Description
texts.value: Run sessions, channels, tools, and events through a Gateway under the operator’s control.

texts.label: Capabilities / 3 / Description
texts.value: Use WebChat or configure supported adapters such as Telegram, Slack, Discord, Signal, and others.

texts.label: Capabilities / 4 / Description
texts.value: Keep the default pairing policy for common messaging channels unless the operator explicitly changes it.

texts.label: Capabilities / 5 / Description
texts.value: Use bundled, managed, or workspace skills with explicit instructions and supporting resources.

texts.label: Capabilities / 6 / Description
texts.value: Connect documented Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, or Android surfaces when the setup requires them.

texts.label: Hero / Workflow / Title
texts.value: Move from install to one deliberately configured assistant path.

texts.label: Hero / Workflow / Lead
texts.value: A reference setup confirms the local Gateway, one model, one channel, and the applicable access policy before expanding.

texts.label: Workflow / 1 / Description
texts.value: Install the CLI and configure the Gateway, workspace, model authentication, and daemon mode.

texts.label: Workflow / 2 / Description
texts.value: Start with WebChat or one supported adapter and keep its inbound access policy explicit.

texts.label: Workflow / 3 / Description
texts.value: Introduce only the instructions and tools required for the first job.

texts.label: Workflow / 4 / Description
texts.value: Check Gateway status, exercise the channel, and use the security runbook before remote exposure.

texts.label: Principles / 1 / Description
texts.value: The operator chooses the models, channels, tools, access policies, and exposure path.

texts.label: Principles / 2 / Description
texts.value: Pairing, allowlists, sandbox settings, and exposure guidance should be reviewed before use.

texts.label: Principles / 3 / Description
texts.value: Validate one model, channel, and skill path before adding more integrations.

texts.label: SEO / Page Description
texts.value: CinaToken is a self-hosted AI gateway with model routing, API keys, budgets, accounting, audit, and documented multimodal interfaces.

texts.label: Hero / Title
texts.value: Route model access through one governed gateway.

texts.label: Hero / Lead
texts.value: CinaToken combines provider routing, API keys, model policy, budgets, accounting, and audit with local, Docker, database, and Cloudflare deployment paths. This page does not claim a managed-service SLA.

texts.label: Capabilities / 1 / Description
texts.value: Connect applications through documented Chat Completions, Responses, image, audio, embedding, Realtime, Claude, and Gemini routes.

texts.label: Capabilities / 2 / Description
texts.value: Keep provider credentials behind the gateway and manage user-facing API keys from the administration layer.

texts.label: Capabilities / 3 / Description
texts.value: Route by explicit provider, model, task, availability, and policy configuration.

texts.label: Capabilities / 4 / Description
texts.value: Use the project’s budget, accounting, status, and model-access controls for governed consumption.

texts.label: Capabilities / 5 / Description
texts.value: Inspect routing, policy, usage, and accounting through the documented console and management APIs.

texts.label: Capabilities / 6 / Description
texts.value: Run locally, in Docker, with supported databases, or through the documented Cloudflare deployment path.

texts.label: Hero / Workflow / Title
texts.value: Move one application through a governed model route.

texts.label: Hero / Workflow / Lead
texts.value: A reference rollout starts with one protocol, provider route, downstream key, budget rule, and observable request.

texts.label: Workflow / 1 / Description
texts.value: Select the documented protocol and confirm the application request shape.

texts.label: Workflow / 2 / Description
texts.value: Add the provider credential securely and restrict the route to the intended models.

texts.label: Workflow / 3 / Description
texts.value: Create the user or application identity with its applicable model and budget boundaries.

texts.label: Workflow / 4 / Description
texts.value: Send a test request, then confirm routing, response, accounting, and trace evidence.

texts.label: Principles / 1 / Description
texts.value: Operators choose the hosting path, providers, keys, and data stores.

texts.label: Principles / 2 / Description

texts.label: Principles / 3 / Description

data.title: CinaSkill — Reusable capability format for CinaClaw

texts.label: SEO / Page Description
texts.value: CinaSkill describes focused SKILL.md-based capabilities used with CinaClaw workspaces; it is not presented as a standalone hosted service.

texts.label: Hero / Title
texts.value: Package focused instructions and resources for reuse in CinaClaw.

texts.label: Hero / Lead
texts.value: CinaSkill is the SKILL.md-based capability format used by bundled, managed, and workspace skills in CinaClaw. It does not claim a separate hosted service or standalone release.

texts.label: Capabilities / 1 / Description
texts.value: Use SKILL.md to describe when the capability applies, what it needs, and how it should operate.

texts.label: Capabilities / 2 / Description
texts.value: Separate a useful capability from unrelated workflows, permissions, and tools.

texts.label: Capabilities / 3 / Description
texts.value: Reference runbooks, templates, scripts, or examples that the skill actually needs.

texts.label: Capabilities / 4 / Description
texts.value: Use bundled, managed, or workspace skill directories according to the CinaClaw setup.

texts.label: Capabilities / 5 / Description
texts.value: State the tools, external systems, and side effects the capability can require.

texts.label: Capabilities / 6 / Title
texts.value: Keep loading order and version visible.

texts.label: Capabilities / 6 / Description
texts.value: Document the workspace location, version, and runtime or resource assumptions the capability carries.

texts.label: Hero / Workflow / Title
texts.value: Move one recurring job into a reviewable skill contract.

texts.label: Hero / Workflow / Lead
texts.value: A reference skill starts with a real task, narrows the required resources and permissions, and is tested inside its intended CinaClaw workspace.

texts.label: Workflow / 1 / Description
texts.value: Write the task and the conditions under which the skill should be selected.

texts.label: Workflow / 2 / Description
texts.value: Describe required inputs, instructions, tools, resources, and expected output in SKILL.md.

texts.label: Workflow / 3 / Description
texts.value: Exercise the skill with representative inputs and review any tool or permission boundary.

texts.label: Workflow / 4 / Description
texts.value: Keep compatibility, supporting resources, and workspace loading behavior clear as the workflow changes.

texts.label: Principles / 1 / Description
texts.value: A skill should remain small enough for its behavior and permissions to be reviewed.

texts.label: Principles / 2 / Description
texts.value: Supporting files and tools should be present because the task requires them.

texts.label: Principles / 3 / Description
texts.value: CinaSkill is described as a format integrated with CinaClaw, not an independent hosted product.

texts.label: Hero / Lead
